newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria favours Polish blue-chips, IPOs.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria favours Polish blue-chips, IPOs.

text.p: The Polish stock market has limited upside after a strong bull run early this year and highly liquid blue chips and primary issues are likely to be this year's best buys, Investmentbank Austria said in a report.

It said in a report dated January 29, that the Warsaw exchange was unlikely to repeat last year's performance when the market grew 62 percent in dollar terms and flat 1996 earnings were likely to trigger a significant correction.

"...When the euphoria of the new year buying spree recedes and investors realise the market has got ahead of itself in terms of the price/growth relationship, we expect that a correction will occur," it said.
"As we do not expect a recovery in the market until late 1997 we recommend that investors focus on the blue-chip shares for liquidity as well as search for bargains on the primary market," it added.
IB Austria said it continued to favour such sectors as food and beverages, construction and paints.
